items.fullText: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark Nemotron 3.5 Bolt, NVIDIA PAIR and NVIDIA Broadcast 2.3 adding to the thousands of apps, games and models ready for RTX Spark launch on Friday, Oct. 16. October 13, 2026 by Gerardo Delgado 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA RTX Spark is a new beginning for the PC — a reinvention combining the capabilities of a gaming PC, a creative studio and a personal AI supercomputer into a single superchip. With up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute, RTX Spark delivers the full stack of NVIDIA RTX and CUDA technologies for creators, developers and gamers, while unlocking a new paradigm in personal computing via powerful local AI agents. Last week, NVIDIA and Microsoft announced that RTX Spark laptops will be available on Friday, Oct. 16 . Ahead of the launch, NVIDIA and its ecosystem partners are rolling out new software features and performance optimizations to expand what’s possible with local AI on RTX Spark. New and upcoming RTX Spark updates — among the thousands of apps, games and models available at launch — include: New agent features, models and tools that enhance local agents on RTX Spark: Updates to top agent apps including GitHub Copilot, Hermes, OpenClaw, Perplexity, Pi and WorkBuddy streamline setup on RTX Spark, improve security with OpenShell and Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC), and enable hybrid local and cloud AI routing. The NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B model, purpose-built for agentic AI on RTX Spark, releases on Thursday, Oct. 15. NVIDIA PAIR moves out of beta and adds llama.cpp support. Top creative apps optimized for RTX Spark: Up to 2x performance is coming soon to Adobe’s top apps. NVIDIA and Adobe have collaborated to rearchitect Photoshop for GPU-accelerated compositing and Premiere for playback, rendering, effects and more. items.t: 오픈AI 감싸고 엔비디아 때린 브로드컴 "맞춤형 칩이 미래"
items.fullText: 테크 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 오픈AI 감싸고 엔비디아 때린 브로드컴 "맞춤형 칩이 미래" 입력 2026.10.13 17:58 수정 2026.10.13 17:58 지면 A19 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 김인엽 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. AI 반도체주 팔아치운 투자자에 탄 CEO "도박꾼" 빗대며 비판 자사 칩 경쟁우위 강조하려 한듯 “많은 투자자가 자신이 무엇에 투자하는지 전혀 모릅니다. 높은 기대를 품지만 결국에는 카지노에 온 것과 다름없다는 걸 깨닫게 됩니다.” 혹 탄 브로드컴 최고경영자(CEO·사진)가 12일(현지시간) 싱가포르에서 열린 포럼에서 한 이 발언이 반도체주 급락의 계기가 됐다. 인공지능(AI) 투자자들이 도박을 벌이고 있다는 의미로 해석되면서 이날 브로드컴(-1.88%) 엔비디아(-1.29%) Arm(-4.15%) 등을 포함한 필라델피아반도체지수는 전날보다 2.67% 떨어졌다. AI 칩 공급사인 브로드컴이 스스로 시장에 찬물을 끼얹은 셈이다. AI 열풍의 한가운데 있는 그가 자충수를 둔 것으로 보이지만, 오히려 AI의 장기적 가치를 강조한 것이란 분석이 나온다. 블룸버그통신에 따르면 탄 CEO의 발언은 최근 오픈AI 매출에 실망한 투자자를 겨냥한 것이다. 최근 오픈AI의 연환산 매출이 시장 예상치(700억달러)보다 적은 500억달러라는 파이낸셜타임스(FT) 보도에 AI 반도체주를 팔아치운 투자자를 단기 실적에 연연하는 ‘도박꾼’에 빗댄 것이다. 탄 CEO는 “오픈AI가 연환산 매출 500억달러를 거둔 것은 스타트업으로서는 나쁘지 않다”고 평가하며 “오픈AI 같은 첨단 모델 개발사가 향후 소프트웨어 기업을 대체하면서 더 많은 가치를 가져갈 것”이라고 내다봤다. 그는 이어 “이들 첨단 모델 개발사는 약 1000억달러를 지출해 1200억달러 매출을 거두지만, 개방형 모델 진영은 비슷한 1000억달러를 쓰고도 매출이 300억달러에 불과하다”고 강조했다. 이런 발언에 대해 경쟁사인 엔비디아를 견제하고 자사 맞춤형 반도체의 경쟁 우위를 강조하기 위한 것이란 해석이 제기된다. 탄 CEO가 높게 평가한 오픈AI, 앤트로픽, 구글은 브로드컴의 맞춤형 반도체를 쓰거나 개발하고 있다. 반면 엔비디아는 그래픽처리장치(GPU) 시장을 확대하기 위해 탄 CEO가 깎아내린 개방형 모델 생태계를 지원하고 있다. 그는 “특정 AI 작업에서는 800W 전력을 쓰는 맞춤형 칩이 1.4㎾를 쓰는 범용 GPU보다 뛰어난 성능을 낼 수 있다”고 주장했다. 최적화된 자사 칩으로 비용 경쟁력을 확보할 수 있다는 논리다. 탄 CEO는 “AI 생태계의 최대 병목은 메모리가 아니라 자본”이라고도 했다. 자금 부족론은 브로드컴의 금융 전략과 맞물린다. 브로드컴은 블랙스톤, 아폴로 등 금융회사와 협력해 앤트로픽의 AI 칩 확보를 위한 600억달러 구조화 금융 패키지를 주도했다. 오픈AI용 칩을 위한 500억달러 이상의 자금 조달도 추진하고 있다. 실리콘밸리=김인엽 특파원 inside@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 김인엽 특파원 한국경제신문 실리콘밸리 김인엽 특파원입니다. 정치부, 국제부를 거쳐 테크앤사이언스부에 있습니다. 현재 실리콘밸리 빅테크와 스타트업, 캘리포니아에서 일어나는 흥미로운 일들을 취재하고 있습니다. items.t: 엔비디아 "피지컬 AI 승부처는 시뮬레이션"…정부도 실증 지원
items.fullText: 테크 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 엔비디아 "피지컬 AI 승부처는 시뮬레이션"…정부도 실증 지원 입력 2026.10.13 15:01 수정 2026.10.13 15:01 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 라현진 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 13일 '피지컬 AI 테크 위크' 개막 인텔 "로봇 대규모 도입 준비된 기업 40%뿐" 배경훈 "피지컬 AI 글로벌 1강 도약" 정소영 엔비디아코리아 대표가 13일 서울 삼성동 코엑스 '피지컬 AI 테크위크'에서 특별 강연을 하고 있다. / 사진=라현진 기자 "피지컬 AI에서는 시뮬레이션이 굉장히 중요합니다. 실제 환경의 데이터가 부족하고 안전과 비용 문제도 해결해야 하기 때문입니다." 정소영 엔비디아코리아 대표는 13일 서울 삼성동 코엑스에서 열린 '피지컬 AI 테크 위크' 특별강연에서 피지컬 AI의 산업 현장 확산을 위한 핵심 기술로 시뮬레이션을 꼽았다. 인공지능(AI)이 디지털 공간을 넘어 공장과 로봇 등 현실 세계에서 움직이려면 가상환경에서 충분히 학습하고 검증해야 한다는 설명이다. 과학기술정보통신부가 주최한 이번 행사는 피지컬 AI 기술 개발부터 실증, 투자, 사업화까지 연결하기 위해 마련됐다. 크래프톤, 엔비디아, 인텔 등 국내외 기업이 기술과 산업 전망을 공유했다. 정 대표는 가상환경에서 잘 작동하는 AI라도 현실에서 똑같이 작동하는 것은 아니라며 두 환경의 차이를 줄이는 기술이 중요하다고 강조했다. 엔비디아는 가상환경 플랫폼 '옴니버스', 월드 파운데이션 모델 '코스모스', 로봇 개발 플랫폼 '아이작' 등으로 데이터 생성부터 학습·검증을 지원하고 있다. LG와 로봇·피지컬 AI 분야에서 협력하고 있다는 점도 소개했다. 존 힐리 인텔 부사장이 13일 서울 삼성동 코엑스 '피지컬 AI 테크위크'에서 특별 강연을 하고 있다. / 사진=라현진 기자 존 힐리 인텔 부사장은 기술 개발만큼 상용화 준비가 중요하다고 지적했다. 인텔이 세계 5개 지역, 6개 산업의 관계자 약 800명을 조사한 결과 향후 5년간 로봇이 기업 성장에 필수적일 것으로 본 응답자는 약 3분의 2였다. 하지만 로봇의 대규모 도입 전략을 마련했다는 응답은 40%에 그쳤다. 힐리 부사장은 안전성과 실시간 반응, 전력 효율, 시스템 간 호환성을 주요 과제로 제시했다. 이강욱 크래프톤 최고인공지능책임자(CAIO)는 로봇의 '사회적 지능'을 강조했다. 로봇이 걷거나 물건을 집는 능력뿐 아니라 사람의 말을 이해하고 상황에 따라 행동을 바꿔야 한다는 것이다. 크래프톤은 음성과 동작을 함께 처리하는 통합 로봇 기초모델을 내년 초 공개할 계획이다. 정부도 기술 개발을 실제 사업으로 연결하는 데 정책 역량을 집중하기로 했다. 배경훈 부총리 겸 과기정통부 장관은 이날 피지컬 AI 얼라이언스 관계자들과 간담회를 열고 산업별 실증과제와 표준화, 데이터 확보 등 추진 상황을 점검했다. 배 부총리는 "글로벌 경쟁이 본격화된 상황에서 누가 먼저 산업 현장에서 작동하는 기술을 만들고 확산하느냐가 중요하다"며 "우리의 AI·ICT 역량과 제조 기반을 결집하면 글로벌 1강으로 도약할 수 있다"고 말했다. 이어 관계부처 사업과 정책금융을 연계해 기업의 기술 개발이 현장 실증과 투자, 사업화로 이어지도록 지원하겠다고 밝혔다. 정부는 이날 제조·물류·농업·항만 분야의 2027년 피지컬 AI 사업 방향도 소개했다. 14일에는 AI 추론 인프라와 로봇 기초모델 등을 논의하는 '피지컬 AI 테크 데이'가 열린다. 라현진 기자 raraland@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴

items.fullText: From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA French companies are putting NVIDIA infrastructure and open models to work across all industries, from satellites in orbit to cosmetics in corner stores. October 12, 2026 by Nat Ives 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Companies in France are deploying agentic computing across industries spanning space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, demonstrating how the country’s ecosystem has moved from ambition to application. France’s progress sits on deliberate groundwork. The AI Action Summit in February 2025 and Choose France Summits in 2025 and 2026 anchored major compute commitments on French soil. What the ecosystem has built since then spans the full stack. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Sovereign AI Infrastructure France-based companies are expanding agentic infrastructure on NVIDIA technology. Bull is extending its European AI server production to NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ultra NVL72 systems, planned for 2028, with trays produced in Europe and rack integration at its Angers factory — inaugurated Friday, Oct. 2. Altair-1, the first satellite in a $1 billion, 50-satellite constellation with on-board autonomous capabilities, launched this month and has successfully reached orbit. Integrated by Loft Orbital and built in Abu Dhabi by Orbitworks , a joint venture between Loft Orbital and Marlan Space , the satellite is flying NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin edge modules, running Mistral’s models, for real-time Earth observation and autonomous operations in orbit. Open Models NVIDIA Nemotron open models are in production across French organizations that require sovereign, trustworthy data. LINAGORA and Docaposte have secured the CANUT framework agreement , making Twake.ai, built on NVIDIA Nemotron, the sole referenced sovereign digital workplace for more than 2,500 French public organizations. items.fullText: OCP Global Summit: Amid Ecosystem Adoption, NVIDIA Opens Vera Rubin Architecture to Help Scale AI Factories Worldwide Cisco, Google, Meta, Microsoft and Visionbay are joining many making advances with Vera Rubin. October 12, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! As AI factories grow from megawatts to gigawatts, building them takes more than advanced computing. Open standards are helping the industry scale AI infrastructure faster, more efficiently and more reliably. At the Open Compute Project (OCP) Global Summit, taking place in the San Jose McEnery Convention Center, NVIDIA announced new partnerships and contributions aimed at creating a common foundation for next-generation AI infrastructure. NVIDIA contributed key NVIDIA Vera Rubin rack and compute tray designs to OCP through the open NVIDIA MGX architecture, giving system builders a common foundation for developing next-generation AI factory infrastructure. Together, these efforts span the AI factory itself, the utility grid that powers it and the rack-scale architecture at the heart of modern accelerated computing. NVIDIA and Partners Announce Open Architecture Advances At the OCP event, NVIDIA and partners made a handful of announcements: NVIDIA and hyperscalers published open standards for next-generation AI factories, including AI factory design standards and grid resilience. NVIDIA launched new open source software components for NVIDIA DSX AI Factory. Meta and NVIDIA advanced open AI networking with NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet SuperNIC and Spectrum-6 innovations. Visionbay introduced an 800V DC AI factory design for the Vera Rubin era. NVIDIA and Cisco announced the Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP) standard, the industry’s first module ​for 400Gb/s-based networking fabrics. items.d: President Donald Trump joined Michael Kratsios to award the Medal of Science to Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Lisa Su and Sergey Brin amid announcements about new science funding.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Trump awards Musk and other tech titans National Medals of Science President Donald Trump joined Michael Kratsios to award the Medal of Science to Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Lisa Su and Sergey Brin amid announcements about new science funding. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk receives the National Medal of Science from President Donald Trump at the Science: A New Golden Age Summit at the U.S. Institute of Peace on Thursday. Win McNamee / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 8, 2026, 5:43 PM EDT By Jared Perlo WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump joined some of America’s most powerful tech leaders Thursday at a summit the White House billed as the start of a “golden age” of American science. Elon Musk, Google co-founder Sergey Brin, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, AMD CEO Lisa Su, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Dell founder Michael Dell gathered with Trump and a host of administration officials and scientific luminaries for the Science: A New Golden Age Summit at the U.S. Institute of Peace. “We live in an age of American wonders and technological marvels, and with the help of the brilliant men and women here today, we will always be on top,” Trump said. Trump awarded the National Medal of Science to Musk, Brin, Huang and Su. He awarded the National Medal of Technology and Innovation to Nadella and Dell. Michael Kratsios, director of the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, addresses the audience Thursday afternoon at the U.S. Institute of Peace. Jared Perlo / NBC News Trump presented each of the recipients with medals and certificates of honor, later asking some of their families to join him onstage to take photos. “You’re going to go down in the annals of history as being great,” Trump told the recipients. At a Microsoft event in San Francisco on Wednesday, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang and Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella outlined how NVIDIA and Microsoft are co-engineering hardware and software for AI agents to run on Windows PCs. NVIDIA was founded because of Windows, Huang said. Now AI agents are coming to Windows. “If you look at the entire journey of our company, Windows was at the core of it,” Huang said, tracing back NVIDIA’s support for Windows and Microsoft over several decades. “If not for Windows there would be no GeForce.” Huang connected that history — and his long-term vision — to the agentic era Wednesday during a fireside chat with Nadella hosted by Sriram Krishnan, a former senior White House policy advisor on AI at the Windows AI and Surface event, held at Dogpatch Studios in San Francisco. “The thing that I really give Jensen all the credit for, quite frankly, is that consistency of vision of what this can be—not today, not tomorrow, but as a secular trend,” Nadella said. “And that’s what brings us to this moment.” “The personal computer is the ultimate tool, it’s my ultimate tool, and for a whole generation of people, it’s our ultimate tool,” Huang said. “What happens in the era of agents, when the agent is on your computer? It is now your personal assistant.” The event opened with Nadella before Pavan Davuluri, executive vice president of Windows and Devices at Microsoft, walked through the Windows updates designed for the agentic era. items.fullText: Why Telecom Operators Are Building Their AI Strategy on Open Models Telcos are turning to open models to build trusted, production‑ready AI workflows they can deploy, customize and govern across their most critical workloads. October 6, 2026 by Kanika Atri 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Telecom operators are increasingly building their AI strategies on open models — and the reasons go beyond mere cost. Open models give telcos the ability to trust, control and customize AI across their most critical workloads — from autonomous networks to customer care. NVIDIA’s latest State of AI in Telecommunications report reflects this shift, with 89% of respondents reporting that open source models and software are important to their company’s AI strategy. For operators, the strategic value of open models is fivefold: They expand access to frontier‑level intelligence at lower cost, allowing operators to reserve closed models for the workloads where they drive the most value. Independent benchmarks such as the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 show that leading open models are becoming more competitive across demanding reasoning, coding, scientific and agentic workloads. They support telco‑specific customization, with open weights and training recipes that operators can fine‑tune for their own operations using network, customer and industry data. They enable trustworthy AI by giving telcos greater visibility into and control over model artifacts and behavior, so models can be evaluated, adapted and governed in alignment with regulations and business policies. They enable flexible, secure deployment: teams can size and optimize open models to run across public clouds, private infrastructure and edge environments. They unlock the opportunity for telcos to deliver locally adapted AI services to enterprise and government customers by hosting and fine-tuning open models. GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast, running on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs , is available now in the OpenAI API and to eligible ChatGPT Work and Codex users. For developers, faster generation can shorten coding agents’ edit-test-debug cycles, reduce the time spent generating responses between tool calls and make interactive applications feel more responsive. A faster response matters most when it’s repeated across a workflow: an agent writes code, uses a tool, checks the result and decides what to do next. items.fullText: Productive, Durable, Fungible: How NVIDIA AI Factories Maximize Return on Investment AI factories generating the strongest returns are the ones built to earn more, last longer and serve more kinds of work. October 1, 2026 by Shruti Koparkar 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! AI factories are built by the megawatt, even by the gigawatt. Each megawatt factory costs roughly $60 million, and AI factory operators will only commit capital on that scale with a clear view of the return on investment. Three key things shape AI factory returns: Earning capacity: What the factory could earn in a year if it sold every token it can produce. Useful life : How long its AI hardware keeps earning. Demand : How much demand there is for those tokens. Strength cannot fully offset weakness in another. High earning capacity counts for little if the factory sells only part of what it can produce. High demand matters little if it stops producing at full capacity in just a year. Nor are the three independent. A factory that can run more kinds of workloads finds more demand, keeping it earning year after year. NVIDIA AI factories are engineered to maximize all three. They’re: Productive : Delivering the highest throughput per megawatt and the lowest cost per token, which maximizes their earning capacity . Durable : NVIDIA GPUs and systems keep earning years after they ship, extending useful life . Fungible : They run every type of AI — in every phase and every place — as well as many workloads that don’t involve AI at all, which deepens and broadens the demand they can serve. NVIDIA platform is productive, durable and fungible, which maximizes AI factory returns. Engineering codesign across the full stack maximizes AI factory throughput, and continuous software optimization keeps installed hardware productive years after it ships. items.fullText: NVIDIA Opens Applications for 2027–2028 Graduate Fellowships With Awards Up to $60,000 September 30, 2026 by Sharon Gibbons 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Bringing together the world’s brightest minds and the latest accelerated computing technology leads to powerful breakthroughs that help tackle some of the biggest research problems. To foster such innovation, the NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship Program provides grants, mentors and technical support to doctoral students doing outstanding research relevant to NVIDIA technologies. The program, in its 26th year, is now accepting applications worldwide. It focuses on supporting students working in AI, machine learning, autonomous vehicles, computer graphics, robotics, healthcare, high-performance computing and related fields. Awards are up to $60,000 per student. Since its start in 2002, the Graduate Fellowship Program has awarded over 220 grants worth around $8 million. Students must have completed at least their first year of Ph.D.-level studies at the time of application. The application deadline for the 2027-2028 academic year is October 30, 2026. An in-person internship at an NVIDIA research office preceding the fellowship year is mandatory; eligible candidates must be available for the internship in summer 2027. For more on eligibility and how to apply, visit the program website . Featured image shows last year’s NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship recipients. items.fullText: How Open Science Can Help Researchers Prepare for the Next Pandemic NVIDIA is collaborating with organizations including Google DeepMind and the European Molecular Biology Laboratory’s European Bioinformatics Institute to release an open dataset of viral protein structures — giving scientists a head start against diseases. September 24, 2026 by Anthony Costa 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! When COVID-19 emerged, scientists had a crucial advantage: Decades of prior research on coronaviruses meant they understood the virus’ key proteins well enough to design vaccines in record time. The next pandemic may not offer the same head start. To help improve the odds, NVIDIA has joined a coalition of global research organizations, including Google DeepMind and the European Molecular Biology Laboratory’s European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI), to release predicted 3D structures for the protein complexes of more than 2,800 viruses — openly available to any scientist, anywhere, through the AlphaFold Database. The structures in the newly released dataset were inferred using AlphaFold2 — Google DeepMind’s AI model for predicting how proteins fold into 3D shapes — with optimization from NVIDIA BioNeMo Inference Runtime . This allowed the team to scale inference to thousands of viral proteomes, predicting the complexes, or groups of interacting proteins, encoded within each virus. “Our ambition with the AlphaFold Database has always been to democratize access to foundational biology at scale,” said Risha Patel, life sciences partnerships manager at Google DeepMind. “This collaboration to bring thousands of viral complexes into the database will equip scientists around the world with insights they need to help prepare for future outbreaks.” NVIDIA is also openly releasing the BioNeMo Structure Prediction Pipeline , the GPU-accelerated workflow used to generate the dataset, so researchers can go from protein sequence to predicted 3D

items.fullText: Sakeena Fiza Helps NVIDIA Hardware Succeed at Scale By testing systems from lab bring-up to production, validation engineers turn cutting-edge hardware into dependable infrastructure. September 23, 2026 by Matthew Leib 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! When Sakeena Fiza describes her work as a validation engineer at NVIDIA, she does so in terms more befitting a detective story than a world-class engineering lab. “Validation engineers look in the shadows and shine a light into every corner,” Fiza said. “Every time we get a system, our first thought is: how can it break?” And when it does? “I always like to think of it as a mystery to solve,” she said. At NVIDIA, the systems Fiza and her colleagues in the data center systems engineering lab investigate are the engines of the AI era. Her work begins before the rest of the world knows a product exists — in the lab — when a new system first receives power. Components are brought up one by one, boards are integrated, firmware and software teams swarm, and engineers watch for the first signs of life. One of Fiza’s earliest and most enduring memories of working at NVIDIA is the collective joy she experienced when she saw the NVIDIA Rubin GPU working for the first time at a system level. “It literally just said, ‘NVIDIA Corporation Device,’” she recalls. “And everyone’s cheering and celebrating because it’s the first time in the world that a Rubin GPU enumerated at a system level.” Those moments, electric as they are, are only the beginning. From there, the system must be made resilient: from tray to rack to cluster to production line to customer AI factory.
